The '''Mining Droid MK3''' was a model of [[Mining droid/Legends|mining droid]] used on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] by the [[Klegger Corporation]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and later by the [[Mensix Mining Company]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
